'''November 2001 Ventura tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Ventura, California on 3 November 2001. It is known from Wilson Fisher's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3092">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-04-11-3-ventura-boutny-tournamentd3092/ 11-3-ventura-boutny-tournament], DeckTech (Wilson "Your mom" Fisher, 4 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-04-11-3-ventura-boutny-tournamentd3092/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Ventura, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
